name: Reindsurm Butterfly
desc: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
